ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive simulation featuring Vice City NPCs that remember past player actions, possess persistent moods, and talk back via WebRTC voice streaming.
ideas.title: ViceDialog: Real-Time Voice Chat with Procedural NPC Memories
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core track requirement while adopting the winning formula from loremaster by adding real-time voice integration, making the live demo extraordinarily memorable for judges.

ideas.pitch: An interactive dispatch dashboard that ingests simulated player crimes, calculates a 1-5 star wanted level using structured LLM reasoning, and generates escalating police response units.
ideas.problem_statement: AI-Powered Wanted Level and Police Response Simulator
ideas.title: SirenAI: Dynamic Wanted Level and Incident Forecasting Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses probabilistic event generation inspired by winning forecasting systems, presenting a clean live dashboard that visually demonstrates scaling system complexity.

ideas.pitch: A web platform that dynamically crafts open-world missions with custom objectives, timers, and difficulty levels, complete with JSON-driven validation and player state tracking.
ideas.title: ViceQuest: Procedural Storyline and Mission Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relies on robust structured JSON schema enforcement via LLMs, ensuring zero demo-breaking runtime errors during the live judging walkthrough.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent social simulation where two Vice City informants negotiate or betray each other based on hidden AI-driven incentives and player-triggered pressure points.
ideas.title: Syndicate: Adversarial Informant Deception Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced multi-agent psychological game dynamics proven in top-tier self-improving agent hackathon wins, showcasing genuine technical depth beyond basic prompt wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An AI simulation that optimizes police pursuit vectors and road-block placements in real time as the player's wanted level escalates across a grid map.
ideas.problem_statement: AI-Powered Wanted Level and Police Response Simulator
ideas.title: HeatMap: Evolutionary Pursuit Route Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous algorithmic pathfinding and evolutionary logic to a gaming problem, satisfying the judging priority for hard engineering work.
